# Blood on the Clocktower Script Tool

> A free browser-based editor for creating, formatting and printing Blood on the Clocktower scripts.

- [Open the editor](https://botc.letshare.fun/)
- [中文使用说明](https://botc.letshare.fun/zh-cn/)
- [Guía en español](https://botc.letshare.fun/es/)
- [Script directory](https://botc.letshare.fun/scripts/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/LiWeny16/botc-script-tool)

## Features

- Import compatible script JSON or choose a script from the directory
- Edit characters, special rules, jinxes and night order
- Adjust one- or two-page layouts, backgrounds, fonts and images
- Export images and JSON, or use the browser to print and save a PDF

The core editor can be used without an account. Optional cloud features require sign-in.
